## AI understanding
The backend calls this webhook when `AI_MODE=n8n`. It sends the customer's message plus a ready-made prompt. This workflow asks your AI model and returns JSON (intent, area, plot size…).

**The AI never writes to customers.** If anything fails, the backend falls back to buttons + keyword rules.

Set in n8n's environment: `NS_AI_BASE_URL` (OpenAI-compatible, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1), `NS_AI_API_KEY`, `NS_AI_MODEL`, `NS_N8N_SECRET`.

Edit *Build AI request* to add your own instructions.
